3000-3510-4288-5929.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
3000-3510-4288-5929.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1818-4247-5010-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-4247-5010-6900.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

586-2906-3899-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
586-2906-3899-5258-5618.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1325-5170-5231-6132.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-5042-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Lyla triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

104-475-4186-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-475-4186-7810.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is modified

3457-5845-7791.description:
Activate Orochi Merge-Keeper by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6709-7719.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-5078-6709-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

782-5540-7512.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an artifact, creature, or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
An opponent controls an artifact.
If you are going to have a nonartifact creature or enchantment enter the battlefield, an opponent must also control either a creature or enchantment respectively.
782-5540-7512.description:
Cause an artifact, creature or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the permanent that entered with an opponent for another permanent of the same type.
Zidane triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the Treasure with an opponent for another artifact.
Repeat from step 3.
782-5540-7512.notes: Grand Abolisher prevents the opponents from sacrificing the Treasures for mana. Without it, your opponents can sacrifice the Treasures and stop you (eventually) from exchanging control of artifacts.

457-1458-4404-5998.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-5998.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2539-3094-4659-4785-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-4785-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4068-6705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1563-3899-4068-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3129-3809-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
3129-3809-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create two Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.
3129-3809-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

874-1170-1329-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-4068.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

81-1495-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
81-1495-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

2034-5497-6351-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Teval triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat.
2034-5497-6351-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

1690-1976-2364-2538.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact permanent in hand that can be cast for at most {1} due to Etherium Sculptor.
1690-1976-2364-2538.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying at most {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-1976-2364-2538.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

1849-3358-4881.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1449-2713-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Plundering Barbarian.
When Plundering Barbarian enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1263-2018-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Bloodsoaked Champion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {1}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

628-5147-5523.notablePrerequisites: Defiant Greatmaw does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-5147-5523.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
Defiant Greatmaw's second ability triggers, removing a -1/-1 counter from another creature you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1283-4078-4242-4659-5070.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1283-4078-4242-4659-5070.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

876-1475-5147.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Lightning Greaves attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
876-1475-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with Lightning Greaves attached.
When the creature dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

722-3153-3680.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun and Stunt Double each trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

18-4091.notablePrerequisites:
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one other card in hand.
18-4091.description:
Cast Hangar Scrounger by paying {2}{R}.
When Hangar Scrounger enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Aphetto Alchemist and causing it to gain the printed ability until end of turn.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Aphetto Alchemist triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability from step 3, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

185-796-2104-2501-3098.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} on the first turn, with at most {6}{U}{U}{U} available each other extra turn
185-796-2104-2501-3098.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
185-796-2104-2501-3098.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creaature with power two or greater.
Temporal Manipulation's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.
Resolve the Temporal Manipulation trigger, copying it.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve both Temporal Manipulations, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your last extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a Zombie, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Temporal Manipulation and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Zombie, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Temporal Manipulation and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Repeat from step 7.

1429-2169-4050.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding one mana of any color.
Lesser Masticore dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-1558-1977.notablePrerequisites:
Tivit does not have summoning sickness.
Tivit cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1308-1558-1977.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Tivit.
Tivit triggers, creating at least six artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

575-1315-2345.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken land creature.
575-1315-2345.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a nontoken land creature.
The land creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning it to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
The Forest enters the battlefield, triggering Embodiment of Insight, causing the Forest to become a 3/3 Elemental creature with haste in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability from step 1, causing you to gain two life.
Activate the Elemental by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

3783-4300-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
3783-4300-5256.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning a land you control to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Illusion token.
The Illusion dies, triggering Minn's second ability, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Illusion's power.
Repeat.
